meta: A starter sprint to fix broken connections, update to new API versions and set up monitoring. From $50, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Integration support when other tools change
overview: When a payment, shipping or CRM tool changes its API, your connection can quietly stop working. This starter sprint covers the first round of care. We check each integration, fix what is broken, update to the provider's current version where needed, and set up simple monitoring so you hear about the next failure early. Monthly support after the sprint is quoted separately.

faq: No. This is a fixed starter sprint with a first round of checking and fixing. Monthly care is quoted separately if you want us on call after it ends.
What do you need to start?
Access to your project or hosting as a collaborator, the name of the broken tool and any error messages you have seen. We never ask for passwords in messages.
Can you fix an integration I did not build with you?
Yes. We read the code first, find what changed and fix it in your existing style. If the cause is outside our reach, such as a closed account, we tell you plainly.
What if the other tool shuts down its API?
Then we explain your options, which may include a replacement tool. A migration is a bigger job and is quoted separately, so you stay in control of cost.
